constraints: CREATE CONSTRAINT alm_node_uid IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:AlmNode) REQUIRE n.uid IS UNIQUE
CREATE INDEX alm_node_key IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:AlmNode) ON (n.key)
CREATE INDEX alm_node_updated IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:AlmNode) ON (n.updated)
CREATE INDEX alm_node_bucket IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:AlmNode) ON (n.bucket)
CREATE INDEX alm_node_seen IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:AlmNode) ON (n.last_seen_version)
CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX alm_node_text IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:AlmNode) ON EACH [n.title, n.description, n.acceptance_criteria]
CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX alm_node_test_text IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:Test) ON EACH [n.title, n.gherkin, n.unstructured, n.steps_text, n.test_steps, n.manual_steps, n.cucumber_script]
delete_all:
MATCH (n:AlmNode)
WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
WITH n LIMIT $limit
DETACH DELETE n
RETURN count(*) AS deleted
label_counts:
MATCH (n:AlmNode)
WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
UNWIND labels(n) AS label
WITH label WHERE label <> 'AlmNode'
RETURN label, count(*) AS count
ORDER BY count DESC, label

prune_calls.statement:
MATCH (a)-[r]->()
WHERE a.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND coalesce(r.last_seen_version, -1) < $version
WITH r LIMIT $limit
DELETE r
RETURN count(*) AS deleted

MATCH (a)-[r]->()
WHERE a.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND coalesce(r.last_seen_version, -1) < $version
WITH r LIMIT $limit
DELETE r
RETURN count(*) AS deleted

MATCH (n:AlmNode)
WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND coalesce(n.last_seen_version, -1) < $version
WITH n LIMIT $limit
DETACH DELETE n
RETURN count(*) AS deleted

MATCH (n:AlmNode)
WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND coalesce(n.last_seen_version, -1) < $version
WITH n LIMIT $limit
DETACH DELETE n
RETURN count(*) AS deleted

coverage:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND (n:Story OR n:Epic OR n:Feature OR n:Bug OR n:Task OR n:Requirement)
RETURN coalesce(n.coverage_status, 'UNCOVERED') AS coverage_status,
       count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC
coverage-gaps:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND (n:Story OR n:Epic OR n:Feature OR n:Bug OR n:Task OR n:Requirement)
  AND coalesce(n.coverage_status, 'UNCOVERED') = 'UNCOVERED'
RETURN n.type AS type, count(*) AS count, collect(n.key)[..20] AS sample
ORDER BY count DESC, type
explore:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND ($label IS NULL OR $label IN labels(n))
  AND ($search IS NULL OR toLower(coalesce(n.name, '')) CONTAINS toLower($search)
       OR toLower(coalesce(n.key, '')) CONTAINS toLower($search))
WITH n LIMIT $limit
WITH collect(n) AS ns
UNWIND ns AS a
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r]-(b) WHERE b IN ns
WITH ns, collect(DISTINCT r) AS rs
RETURN [x IN ns | {uid: x.uid, labels: [l IN labels(x) WHERE l <> 'AlmNode'],
         name: coalesce(x.name, x.key, x.uid), key: x.key, status: x.status,
         bucket: x.bucket}] AS nodes,
       [rr IN rs WHERE rr IS NOT NULL |
         {type: type(rr), source: startNode(rr).uid, target: endNode(rr).uid}] AS edges
hierarchy:
MATCH (c:AlmNode)-[:CHILD_OF]->(p) WHERE c.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
RETURN c.key AS child, c.type AS child_type, p.key AS parent,
       coalesce(c.hierarchy_depth, 0) AS depth
ORDER BY depth DESC, parent, child
history:
MATCH (e:AlmNode:ChangeEvent)-[:ON]->(i:Issue)
WHERE i.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
MATCH (e)-[:CHANGED]->(f:FieldChange)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:BY]->(u:User)
RETURN i.key AS key, e.created AS at, u.display_name AS who,
       f.field AS field, f.from AS before, f.to AS after
ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT $limit
labels:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
UNWIND labels(n) AS label
WITH label WHERE label <> 'AlmNode'
RETURN label, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC, label
links:
MATCH (a:AlmNode:Issue)-[r]->(b:Issue) WHERE a.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND r.link_type IS NOT NULL
RETURN a.key AS from, type(r) AS relationship, r.link_type AS link_type,
       b.key AS to ORDER BY from, relationship, to
orphan-tests:
MATCH (t:AlmNode:Test) WHERE t.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND coalesce(t.is_orphan, true)
RETURN t.key AS key, t.status AS status, t.title AS title ORDER BY key
relationships:
MATCH (a:AlmNode)-[r]->() WHERE a.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
RETURN type(r) AS type, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC, type
similar-issues:
CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes('alm_node_text', $q) YIELD node, score
WITH node AS n, score
WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND n.key <> coalesce($key, '') AND (n:Story OR n:Epic OR n:Feature OR n:Bug OR n:Task OR n:Requirement)
WITH n, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'similar' AS relation, toString(score) AS via, n.key AS key, n.type AS type,
       n.status AS status, n.title AS title, n.description AS description,
       n.acceptance_criteria AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin, [] AS steps,
       null AS run_status, n.created AS created, n.updated AS updated, score
similar-tests:
CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes('alm_node_test_text', $q) YIELD node, score
WITH node AS t, score
WHERE t.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND t:Test
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:COVERS]->(c:AlmNode)
WITH t, score, collect(DISTINCT c.key) AS covers
WHERE NOT coalesce($key, '') IN covers
WITH t, score, covers ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $limit
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[hs:HAS_STEP]->(st)
WITH t, score, covers, hs, st ORDER BY hs.index
WITH t, score, covers, collect(CASE WHEN st IS NULL THEN null ELSE
  {index: hs.index, action: st.action, data: st.data, expected: st.expected} END) AS steps
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:LATEST_RUN]->(run)
RETURN 'similar-test' AS relation, toString(score) AS via, t.key AS key,
       coalesce(t.type, t.test_type) AS type, t.status AS status, t.title AS title,
       t.description AS description, null AS acceptance_criteria, t.gherkin AS gherkin,
       steps, coalesce(run.status, t.run_status) AS run_status,
       t.created AS created, t.updated AS updated, score, covers
sprint-load:
MATCH (n:AlmNode:Issue)-[m:IN_SPRINT]->(s:Sprint)
WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND m.current
RETURN s.name AS sprint, s.state AS state, n.bucket AS bucket,
       count(*) AS count ORDER BY sprint, bucket
stale:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND coalesce(n.last_seen_version, -1) < $version
RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n.uid AS uid, n.key AS key,
       n.last_seen_version AS last_seen ORDER BY uid
story-changes:
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
MATCH (e:AlmNode:ChangeEvent)-[:ON]->(s)
MATCH (e)-[:CHANGED]->(f:FieldChange)
WHERE f.field =~ $field_re OR f.field_id IN split($field_ids, ',')
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:BY]->(u:User)
WITH e, f, u ORDER BY e.created DESC LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'change' AS relation, e.created AS at, u.display_name AS who,
       f.field AS field, f.field_id AS field_id, f.from AS before, f.to AS after,
       null AS loaded
UNION ALL
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:AlmNode:ChangeEvent) WHERE e.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
WITH e LIMIT 1
RETURN 'meta' AS relation, null AS at, null AS who, null AS field, null AS field_id,
       null AS before, null AS after, e IS NOT NULL AS loaded
story-context:
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
RETURN 'self' AS relation, null AS via, s.key AS key,
       coalesce(s.type, s.test_type) AS type, s.status AS status,
       s.title AS title, s.description AS description,
       s.acceptance_criteria AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin,
       [] AS steps, null AS run_status,
       s.created AS created, s.updated AS updated
UNION ALL
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
MATCH (s)-[:CHILD_OF*1..2]->(p:AlmNode)
WITH DISTINCT p LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'ancestor' AS relation, null AS via, p.key AS key,
       coalesce(p.type, p.test_type) AS type, p.status AS status,
       p.title AS title, p.description AS description,
       p.acceptance_criteria AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin,
       [] AS steps, null AS run_status,
       p.created AS created, p.updated AS updated
UNION ALL
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
MATCH (s)-[:CHILD_OF]->(p:AlmNode)<-[:CHILD_OF]-(sib:AlmNode)
WHERE sib <> s AND (sib:Story OR sib:Epic OR sib:Feature OR sib:Bug OR sib:Task OR sib:Requirement)
WITH p, sib ORDER BY sib.updated DESC LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'sibling' AS relation, p.key AS via, sib.key AS key,
       coalesce(sib.type, sib.test_type) AS type, sib.status AS status,
       sib.title AS title, sib.description AS description,
       sib.acceptance_criteria AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin,
       [] AS steps, null AS run_status,
       sib.created AS created, sib.updated AS updated
UNION ALL
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
MATCH (s)-[r]-(li:AlmNode:Issue) WHERE r.link_type IS NOT NULL
WITH r, li LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'link:' + type(r) AS relation, r.link_type AS via, li.key AS key,
       coalesce(li.type, li.test_type) AS type, li.status AS status,
       li.title AS title, li.description AS description,
       li.acceptance_criteria AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin,
       [] AS steps, null AS run_status,
       li.created AS created, li.updated AS updated
UNION ALL
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_COMPONENT|HAS_LABEL]->(tag)<-[:HAS_COMPONENT|HAS_LABEL]-(peer:AlmNode)
WHERE peer <> s AND (peer:Story OR peer:Epic OR peer:Feature OR peer:Bug OR peer:Task OR peer:Requirement)
WITH peer, collect(DISTINCT coalesce(tag.name, tag.path)) AS tags
ORDER BY size(tags) DESC, peer.updated DESC LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'shared-tag' AS relation, reduce(acc = '', t IN tags | acc + CASE acc WHEN '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + t) AS via, peer.key AS key,
       coalesce(peer.type, peer.test_type) AS type, peer.status AS status,
       peer.title AS title, peer.description AS description,
       peer.acceptance_criteria AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin,
       [] AS steps, null AS run_status,
       peer.created AS created, peer.updated AS updated
UNION ALL
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:CHILD_OF]->(:AlmNode)<-[:CHILD_OF]-(sib:AlmNode)
  WHERE sib <> s AND (sib:Story OR sib:Epic OR sib:Feature OR sib:Bug OR sib:Task OR sib:Requirement)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[r]-(li:AlmNode:Issue) WHERE r.link_type IS NOT NULL
WITH s, collect(DISTINCT sib) + collect(DISTINCT li) + [s] AS scope
UNWIND scope AS n
MATCH (t:AlmNode:Test)-[:COVERS]->(n)
WITH DISTINCT t, n LIMIT $limit
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[hs:HAS_STEP]->(st)
WITH t, n, hs, st ORDER BY hs.index
WITH t, n, collect(CASE WHEN st IS NULL THEN null ELSE
  {index: hs.index, action: st.action, data: st.data, expected: st.expected} END) AS steps
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:LATEST_RUN]->(run)
RETURN 'test' AS relation, n.key AS via, t.key AS key,
       coalesce(t.type, t.test_type) AS type, t.status AS status,
       t.title AS title, t.description AS description,
       t.acceptance_criteria AS acceptance_criteria, t.gherkin AS gherkin,
       steps AS steps, coalesce(run.status, t.run_status) AS run_status,
       t.created AS created, t.updated AS updated
UNION ALL
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:CHILD_OF]->(:AlmNode)<-[:CHILD_OF]-(sib:AlmNode)
  WHERE sib <> s AND (sib:Story OR sib:Epic OR sib:Feature OR sib:Bug OR sib:Task OR sib:Requirement)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[r]-(li:AlmNode:Issue) WHERE r.link_type IS NOT NULL
WITH s, collect(DISTINCT sib) + collect(DISTINCT li) + [s] AS scope
UNWIND scope AS n
MATCH (b:AlmNode:Bug)-[r]-(n)
WHERE b <> n AND (r.link_type IS NOT NULL OR type(r) = 'CHILD_OF')
WITH DISTINCT b, n LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'bug' AS relation, n.key AS via, b.key AS key,
       coalesce(b.type, b.test_type) AS type, b.status AS status,
       b.title AS title, b.description AS description,
       b.acceptance_criteria AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin,
       [] AS steps, null AS run_status,
       b.created AS created, b.updated AS updated
UNION ALL
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_COMMENT]->(c:AlmNode)
WITH c ORDER BY c.created DESC LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'comment' AS relation, c.created AS via, null AS key, null AS type,
       null AS status, null AS title, c.body AS description,
       null AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin, [] AS steps, null AS run_status,
       c.created AS created, null AS updated
UNION ALL
MATCH (s:AlmNode) WHERE s.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND s.key = $key
MATCH (pg:AlmNode:Page)-[:MENTIONS]->(s)
WITH pg LIMIT $limit
RETURN 'page' AS relation, pg.url AS via, 'page:' + pg.page_id AS key,
       'page' AS type, pg.status AS status, pg.title AS title, null AS description,
       null AS acceptance_criteria, null AS gherkin, [] AS steps, null AS run_status,
       null AS created, null AS updated
stubs:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND n.stub
RETURN n.uid AS uid, n.key AS key, labels(n) AS labels ORDER BY uid
summary:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
WITH count(n) AS nodes
MATCH (a:AlmNode)-[r]->() WHERE a.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
RETURN nodes, count(r) AS relationships
test-dates:
MATCH (t:AlmNode:Test) WHERE t.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
WITH count(t) AS tests, count(t.created) AS tests_with_created,
     count(t.updated) AS tests_with_updated, count(t.steps_text) AS tests_with_steps_text
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:AlmNode:ChangeEvent) WHERE e.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
WITH tests, tests_with_created, tests_with_updated, tests_with_steps_text,
     count(e) AS change_events
OPTIONAL MATCH (f:AlmNode:FieldChange) WHERE f.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
  AND f.field =~ '(?i).*(accept|crit|descr).*'
RETURN tests, tests_with_created, tests_with_updated, tests_with_steps_text,
       change_events, count(f) AS criteria_or_description_edits
traceability:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND (n:Story OR n:Epic OR n:Feature OR n:Bug OR n:Task OR n:Requirement)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)<-[:COVERS]-(t:Test)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:LATEST_RUN]->(run:TestRun)
RETURN n.key AS requirement, n.title AS title,
       coalesce(n.coverage_status, 'UNCOVERED') AS coverage,
       t.key AS test, coalesce(run.status, t.run_status) AS run_status
ORDER BY requirement, test
uncovered:
MATCH (n:AlmNode) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND (n:Story OR n:Epic OR n:Feature OR n:Bug OR n:Task OR n:Requirement)
  AND coalesce(n.coverage_status, 'UNCOVERED') = 'UNCOVERED'
RETURN n.key AS key, n.type AS type, n.status AS status, n.title AS title
ORDER BY key
workload:
MATCH (n:AlmNode:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u:User)
WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH $prefix AND n.status_category <> 'Done'
RETURN u.display_name AS assignee, n.bucket AS bucket, count(*) AS count
ORDER BY count DESC, assignee

relationship_counts:
MATCH (a:AlmNode)-[r]->()
WHERE a.uid STARTS WITH $prefix
RETURN type(r) AS type, count(*) AS count
ORDER BY count DESC, type
